name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Boone goes with none of Bluegill, Perch, or Maggot.
Perch, Birchpool, and Leech belong to different catches.
Royce, Bluegill, and Cedarmere belong to different catches.
Royce goes with at most one of Perch, Cedarmere, and Minnow.
